exceptions.title: keeps focus on an outside target when a triggerless menubar menu closes
exceptions.reason: The case checks where the focus goes when a menu of the menubar closes. The popup of Vase UI has no focus management yet, so the case would pass with no code to test.

Most cases of the block press a trigger of the menubar, and the others move the focus or the highlight with the keys. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet, and Menu has no keys yet. The case `role > sets aria-orientation on the root element` renders only the menubar, in the `describe.for` of the three test menubars. `Menubar.test.tsx` has cases of its own for the role and for `aria-orientation` of the menubar.

exceptions.title: renders detached top-level portal ownership without an accessibility role
exceptions.reason: The case presses a trigger of the menubar to open its menu. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet.

The cases need only the parts of Menu that Vase UI has. They are ported with the other cases of this file that render a menu in the menubar, which need the press of the trigger and the focus management of the popup.
The case of the block renders `Menu.FilterProvider` and `Menu.Input`, which Vase UI does not have.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to give it to the menus of the menubar as the id of their root, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the menubar, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
